meaning:
κατ-αλλαγή, -ῆς, ἡ
(καταλλάσσω), [in LXX: Isa.9:5(4), 2Ma.5:20 * ;]
1. exchange.
2. reconciliation: Rom.5:11; κ. κόσμου, Rom.11:15; διακονία τῆς κ., 2Co.5:18; λόγος τῆς κ., 2Co.5:19.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Not only so, but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received the reconciliation.
But all things are of God, who reconciled us to himself through Jesus Christ, and gave to us the ministry of reconciliation;
